Name: Overflow XP
Author: MarsXsyper
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Redistributes XP gained by max-level skills to other eligible skills, with support for vanilla and SpaceCore skills, multiple distribution modes, Mastery integration, and configurable XP sharing.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Supports all five vanilla skills.[/*]
[*]Supports SpaceCore custom skills.[/*]
[*]Detects each skill's individual maximum level.[/*]
[*]Compatible with [b]Skill Mastery Prestige[/b].[/*]
[*]Supports vanilla Mastery XP.[/*]
[*]Optional SpaceCore skill contribution to Mastery.[/*]
[*]Supports locked/unlocked custom skills.[/*]
[*]Optional [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] integration.[/*]
[/list][heading][size=3]Distribution Modes[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Even Distribution[/b][/*]
[/list]The shared XP is divided as evenly as possible between all eligible skills.
[list]
[*][b]Lowest XP[/b][/*]
[/list]All shared XP is sent to the eligible skill with the lowest current XP. Skills with 0 XP are ignored by this mode.
[list]
[*][b]Highest XP[/b][/*]
[/list]All shared XP is sent to the eligible skill with the highest current XP that hasn't reached its maximum level yet.
[list]
[*][b]Overly Distributed XP[/b][/*]
[/list]XP can be shared even when the skill that originally earned it hasn't reached its maximum level.
This mode is significantly more powerful than the normal distribution modes.

[heading][size=3]Experience Amount[/size][/heading]
You can choose how much XP is shared:
10%
20%
30%
40%
50%
60% — Default
70%
80%
90%
Multiply

[b]Percentage[/b]
A percentage of the XP remains in its primary destination while the rest is distributed.
For example, with the default [b]60%[/b] setting:
100 XP earned

60 XP → primary destination
40 XP → distributedWhen the source skill has already reached its maximum level, its available primary portion can instead go to Mastery when applicable.

[b]Multiply[/b]
Multiply creates a full copy of the original XP for every eligible destination.
For example:
10 XP earned
4 eligible destination skills

Destination 1 → +10 XP
Destination 2 → +10 XP
Destination 3 → +10 XP
Destination 4 → +10 XP

Because of this, Multiply can greatly accelerate skill progression, especially when combined with [b]Overly Distributed XP[/b].

[heading][size=3]Mastery[/size][/heading]
Vanilla skills at their maximum level can contribute to Stardew Valley's Mastery system when Mastery is still available.
SpaceCore skills can also contribute to Mastery if:
SpaceCore Skills Share with Mastery = Enabled

This option is disabled by default.

[heading][size=3]Locked Skills[/size][/heading]
By default, locked custom skills aren't eligible to receive shared XP.

Some spacecore skills have specific unlock conditions, so Overflow XP doesn't simply treat level 0 
as meaning that a skill is locked.
[heading][size=3]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size][/heading]
If [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is installed, Overflow XP can be configured directly in-game.
Available settings:

Distribution Mode
Experience Amount
Share XP with Locked Skills
SpaceCore Skills Share with Mastery
Share XP with Locked Skills

GMCM is optional and isn't required to use the mod.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/color]
